يمتروا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَرُوا (yamtarū) /jam.ta.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# يُمْتَرَوْا (yumtaraw) /jum.ta.raw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
